South Slope, Burnaby: 34 houses and 40 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September, with 5 and 10 sold in the month. It is one of 35 communities the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures break out for Burnaby.
South Slope homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

South Slope, September 2026. Detached houses: 34 listed at month end and 5 sold in September, a sales ratio of 15% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 40 listed at month end and 10 sold in September, a sales ratio of 25% (a sellers’ market).

In South Slope, its share of the houses listed in Burnaby went from 9.0% in June to 7.4% in September and its share of the condos and townhomes listed went from 3.6% to 3.0%. A share that holds steady while the city moves means the community is following the city; a share that drifts means it is moving differently.

items.t: South Slope condos and townhomes for sale

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in South Slope?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 34 houses and 40 condos and townhomes listed in South Slope. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is South Slope a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 15% (a balanced market); condos and townhomes had 25% (a sellers’ market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in South Slope from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 18 houses and 26 condos and townhomes sold in South Slope over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in June with 5 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in September with 10 sold.

faq.q: How big is South Slope compared with the rest of Burnaby?
faq.a: In September 2026, South Slope held 7.4% of the 458 detached houses listed in Burnaby and 3.0% of the 1,333 condos and townhomes listed in Burnaby.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in South Slope?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 45.9% of the 74 homes listed in South Slope and condos and townhomes made up 54.1%; of the 15 that sold, houses were 33.3% and condos and townhomes 66.7%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in South Slope than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 43 to 34 (−20.9%) and condos and townhomes fell from 49 to 40 (−18.4%) between June 2026 and September 2026.
